name: Sanctum (Su)
body:
The witch always has a safe space for their arts. This functions as fairy ring retreat with a caster level equal to the witch’s level, except as follows. The entry point takes the form of a circle of squat stones that glow with arcane runes. The extradimensional space always includes an altar reflecting the witch’s religion or patron and a bubbling cauldron that functions as an alchemist’s lab.

The witch must be at least 13th level before selecting this hex.
